candidates.name: Migraine with abdominal symptoms
support_spans: a 30-minute history of generalized abdominal pain followed by a single episode of vomiting
He had a similar episode 18 months earlier, diagnosed as migraine
candidates.why: The patient's symptoms of abdominal pain, vomiting, and headache are consistent with migraine with abdominal symptoms.

candidates.name: Cyclic vomiting syndrome
support_spans: a single episode of vomiting
Over the next hours he had three additional self‐limited vomiting episodes
candidates.why: The patient's recurrent episodes of vomiting are consistent with cyclic vomiting syndrome.

candidates.name: Basilar migraine
support_spans: diaphoresis, mucocutaneous paleness, dizziness, dysarthria, incoherent speech, and lack of eye contact
candidates.why: The patient's symptoms of dizziness, dysarthria, and incoherent speech are consistent with basilar migraine.

candidates.name: Abdominal migraine
support_spans: a 30-minute history of generalized abdominal pain followed by a single episode of vomiting
candidates.why: The patient's symptoms of abdominal pain and vomiting are consistent with abdominal migraine.

candidates.name: Migraine with aura
support_spans: Brain MRI with an epilepsy protocol was reported as normal for age
candidates.why: A normal brain MRI with an epilepsy protocol helps to rule out other causes of the patient's symptoms, supporting a diagnosis of migraine with aura.

candidates.name: Cyclic vomiting syndrome
support_spans: Complete blood count, serum chemistries, and electrolytes were all within normal limits
candidates.why: Normal laboratory tests help to rule out other causes of the patient's symptoms, supporting a diagnosis of cyclic vomiting syndrome.
